items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 184:1
items.html: Before the sin, the First Man had NRN of Atzilut, and after the sin all the limbs of his soul fell away from him, and there remained in him only the light of the Nefesh in the vessels of the crowns. See above, answer 43. (Item 119).
